adjudication.rationale: In handleNewBooking.ts, evt.destinationCalendar is set to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists (`destinationCalendar: ... : null`). For COLLECTIVE team events, team member calendars are accumulated into `teamDestinationCalendars`, but then appended via `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`. If `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`, this optional-chained push is a no-op, so member destination calendars are indeed dropped. This is directly grounded in the diff and can prevent the intended per-member calendar creation path (which relies on `event.destinationCalendar` being a non-empty array in EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents).
